slot: Terms of service, privacy policy, cookie consent

pick.name: Common Paper ToS + vanilla-cookieconsent (only if needed)
pick.what: Free standard click-through ToS; MIT cookie banner library added only when you set non-essential cookies
pick.why: Free, no per-site fees, and works across many products. With cookieless Umami analytics most sites need no banner

alts.name: Termly
alts.what: Hosted policy generator + consent banner + cookie scanner
alts.why: Best free hosted generator if you'd rather not maintain text
alts.free_limits: Free: 1 policy, banner 10k views/mo, quarterly scans, no edits; Starter USD 10/mo/site

alts.name: iubenda
alts.why: Pay-later pick: policies auto-update with law changes

candidates.name: Common Paper ToS + own privacy policy
Termly
candidates.verdict: Free for one site and one policy

candidates.name: GetTerms
candidates.verdict: Free with branding; USD 5/mo or USD 199 lifetime

decision: Use Common Paper's ToS. Have Claude draft each privacy policy from the actual data flows (sub-processors, retention, DPDP/GDPR rights), then get one lawyer review. Choose cookieless analytics so no banner is needed; add vanilla-cookieconsent only if you add ad pixels. Switch to iubenda if keeping policies current becomes a chore.
details: A lawyer should review the first privacy policy; verify with a lawyer.

verify.note: Common Paper ToS exists (click-through). vanilla-cookieconsent 3.1.0 (2025-02-04, MIT) confirmed on npm. Termly alt confirmed (1 policy, 10k banner views, Starter USD 10/mo annual).
